cohort: 42 asymptomatic pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 via nasopharyngeal swab 24-48 hours before delivery and underwent Cesarean section
finding: The study found evidence of potential vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2 in asymptomatic pregnant women, with five (12%) cases meeting the WHO criteria for intrauterine transmission.
followup_time: At birth and 24 hours after birth
